entries.label: Markdown and Mermaid sample
entries.contentPattern:
# Markdown + Mermaid sample

This preview renders **Markdown** and Mermaid diagrams inside ```mermaid``` fenced blocks.

## Flow

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  A[Markdown / MMD] --> B[Parser]
  B --> C{Source type}
  C -->|.md| D[Markdown parser]
  C -->|.mmd| E[Mermaid]
  D --> F[Native preview]
  E --> F
```

## Table

| File | Rendering |
|---|---|
| .md / .markdown | Markdown with Mermaid blocks |
| .mmd / .mermaid | Standalone Mermaid diagram |

## Code

```ts
const render = async (source: string) => await renderPreview(source);
```

# Product README

Short, practical docs help new users understand what this project does and how to start.

## Quick start

1. Open the app.
2. Choose a Markdown or Mermaid file.
3. Review the preview and export when ready.

## Workflow

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  A[Open file] --> B[Edit Markdown]
  B --> C[Preview]
  C --> D{Ready?}
  D -->|No| B
  D -->|Yes| E[Export HTML or Word]
```

## Notes

| Area | Detail |
|---|---|
| Privacy | Files stay on your computer |
| Runtime | Native Windows application |
| Output | HTML and Word documents |

entries.label: Application architecture
entries.contentPattern:
# Native Application Architecture

The app keeps editing, rendering and exporting local, with native Windows controls and portable documents.

```mermaid
flowchart TB
  subgraph Windows
    A[File picker] --> B[Markdown editor]
    B --> C[Markdown parser]
    B --> D[Mermaid renderer]
    C --> E[Native preview]
    D --> E
    E --> F[HTML export]
    E --> G[Word export]
  end
  H[(Local files)] --> A
  F --> I[Save file]
  G --> I
```

## Responsibilities

- Native controls support editing, preview and document navigation.
- Local services manage files, exports and theme preferences.
- Guarded saves preserve original files when a conflict is detected.

entries.label: Project brief
entries.contentPattern:
# Project Brief

## Goal

Create a reliable local documentation studio that exports clean Markdown and Mermaid documents without a backend.

## Audience

Teams that need to review specs, diagrams, and notes from local files.

## Success criteria

- Open individual files or folders.
- Preview Markdown and Mermaid accurately.
- Save local edits with conflict checks.
- Export HTML and Word documents with visible confidence checks.

## Timeline

```mermaid
  dateFormat  YYYY-MM-DD
  section UX

  section Trust
  Export checks       :         b1, 2026-05-22, 1d
  GitHub Pages docs   :         b2, 2026-05-23, 1d
```
